trainOnly.rule: fitted in every fold and in the shipped model, never a held-out fold, source of no negative. FSboard's letter labels come from forced alignment of fluent fingerspelling by an earlier build of this same model, so they are noisy and partly circular; its rows therefore inform the class shapes and the scale, and no threshold, tier or hyperparameter is read off them. Capped at 250 samples per letter so that posed hands stay the majority, and in each fit a sample is kept only if a fit on the posed sets alone gives it the same letter as the alignment did (agreement of two labellers, against label noise).

estimator.form: Sigma_c = (1 - lam) * S_c + lam * S_pooled, then eigenvalues floored at eps * mean(eigenvalue)
estimator.selection: lam and eps chosen from a 4x3 grid by leave-one-dataset-out over the six shippable sets only, minimizing the mean per-letter held-out false-reject rate at the accept threshold and gate, tie-broken on pooled held-out accuracy. massey and surrey took no part; their numbers in MODEL_REPORT.md are the untouched check. Selecting on the folds makes the reported fold numbers optimistic.

tierRule.foldBar: held-out false-reject <= 0.2 at the accept threshold and gate, AND false-accept on the letter's confusion set <= 0.05
tierRule.untouchedVeto: a letter that clears the fold bar is still demoted to tier 2 if its false-reject rate on massey + surrey, at these shipped thresholds with this shipped model, is above 0.35. The veto can only demote, never promote. A letter with fewer than 30 true rows across those two sets is exempt and tierBasis records its count.
tierRule.honesty: Using massey and surrey for this go/no-go is evaluation, not derived weights, so the license rule holds: they are still in no fit, no threshold, no scale and no hyperparameter. But after this veto NO FULLY UNTOUCHED DATA REMAINS FOR THE TIER DECISION -- every set has now informed which letters get graded, and a future tier claim needs data none of this used.

provenance.notes: DEVELOPMENT ARTIFACT. Bootstrap thresholds, NOT calibrated: they come from public datasets of posed hands, evaluated leave-one-dataset-out (cross-source, not cross-signer), and no learner of this tutor contributed a single hand. Tier 1 means a letter cleared a deliberately lenient development bar on that held-out evaluation AND was not vetoed by the untouched sets (see tierRule and tierBasis); tier 2 letters are shown and taught but never given a verdict. massey and surrey are evaluation-only (doubtful licenses): no weight, threshold, scale or hyperparameter in this file is derived from them, but they now decide tiers, so no fully untouched data is left behind the tier list. Thresholds are fitted on the same pooled held-out scores they are reported against, and lam/eps were chosen on those same folds, so the reported error rates are a floor. The thresholds are also pooled from six fold models and applied to a seventh fitted on all six sets; the measured cost of that transfer is in MODEL_REPORT.md. See training/MODEL_REPORT.md.
